title: game/data/banter.json: the story director's lines, picked by who says them and the run history (roguelite track RL-S1; logic/story-pick.js)

who.description: who it is for: a hub character (chosen, hazel, juniper: their first talk after a run), back_lost (the scene after a lost run), leader (a run's leader before the battle), bureau (a Bureau agent's sight line), rival (Blake before a run battle, RL-S2), thanks_chosen, thanks_hazel, thanks_juniper (their thank-you for a gift, RL-S2), or a resident of Copperleaf by their residents.json id (RS-3: what they say when tapped; check-data refuses anyone else)

when.description: a condition (docs/SCRIPTS.md): the line can be picked while it holds

priority.description: the highest priority of the lines that can be picked wins; a tie is drawn

cooldown.description: runs that must end before it can be said again

must.description: picked before any line without it whenever it can be

script.description: what is said: a script (docs/SCRIPTS.md), most often one line
